Read out of saint.gr's line for 25 Οκτωβρίου, «Άγιοι Μαρκιανός και Μαρτύριος οι νοτάριοι», with the rank word and the office left off.
Read out of the title on the name link behind his place in the line for 25 октября ст. ст., «Маркиан Константинопольский, чтец, мч.», with the grade and the rank word left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 25. октобар ст. ст., „Св. муч. Маркијан и Мартирије.“ — «Св.» is "saint" and not a rank and «муч.» is the martyr grade this corpus keeps in `types`, so both come off and the bare personal name, the first of the heading’s two, is the whole of the form; the heading gives neither man an epithet and the readership is in the body, where this folder keeps it in `office`. `foldchk.py` measured the string as held in sr by `marcian-of-constantinople` and `marcian-of-durostorum`, so this form takes that fold to three folders and the key is in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs`.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 25 октября ст. ст. — «Мчч. Маркиана и Мартирия (ок. 355).»

attestations.note: The life page the two of them share heads «День памяти: 25 октября» and no other day. The name link behind his place gives him the grade the other calendars did not, «Маркиан Константинопольский, чтец, мч.» — a reader of the great church — and that is said in the life; `office` is left unset because `upgrade.py` has no key for it. The day page's troparion (глас 1) and kontakion (глас 4) are addressed to the two of them together, so each folder carries both, as this corpus already does for the seven youths of Ephesus.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul pentru 25 octombrie — «Sfântul Mucenic Marcian»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 25ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιοι Μαρκιανός και Μαρτύριος οι νοτάριοι»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2800/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 25 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps for the Romanian church, and the pair is the same: the two notaries and secretaries of Paul the Confessor, patriarch of Constantinople, killed with a knife for refusing the Arians. Its heading prints «(; - 355)» for each of them, so a `dates` object with the death year alone is proposed; the reign it names, «του Αρειανού βασιλέως Κωνσταντίου (337 - 349 μ.Χ.)», is wider than that and is quoted in the note rather than turned into an interval. Paul is cross-referenced to 6 Νοεμβρίου and has a folder, `paul-the-confessor`, so he is linked and gets a `related` row. Its Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος γ’, and its Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’, both name the two of them and are taken for both folders; the Οἶκος, which also names them, is not a kind the schema holds. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 07.11.2025 (25. октобар ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Маркијан и Мартирије.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, and the heading is an ENUMERATED COMPANY OF TWO — Маркијан and Мартирије — so BRIEF-SERBIAN section 5 counts two names, two folders are owed a row, and the corpus holds both. Quoted whole with its closing full stop (section 4); URL year 2025, as `sr-civil.mjs` gives for the Julian 10-20 to 12-18. The quoted line is the one heading, whole, on both rows, and the two folders already relate one another. `types` AND `office` UNTOUCHED, AND THE ENTRY CONFIRMS BOTH OFFICES WORD FOR WORD. «муч.» is the `martyr` both hold and the standing against Arianism the `confessor`; «Маркијан беше чтец а Мартирије ипођакон при саборној цркви» is exactly the `Reader` and `Subdeacon` the two folders already carry in `office`, confirmed here from a fourth book. AND THE ENTRY ADDS A SECOND OFFICE FOR BOTH THAT THE CORPUS HAS NO FIELD FOR: «под патријархом Павлом беху патријархови нотари (писари)», under the patriarch Paul they were THE PATRIARCH’S NOTARIES, which is also what the Greek line already on these folders calls them, «οι νοτάριοι». `office` holds one string and the reader does not append to it, so the notaryship is here and in the prose. `dates` UNTOUCHED: both folders hold `death` 355 and the entry says «бише посечени, 355. год.» — the same year exactly. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS, AND IT IS A WHOLE CHAPTER OF CHURCH HISTORY. They were clergy under PAUL THE PATRIARCH OF CONSTANTINOPLE in the time of the emperor CONSTANTIUS. AFTER THE DEATH OF CONSTANTINE THE GREAT THE ARIAN HERESY, WHICH HAD BEEN SMOTHERED UNTIL THEN, CAME ALIVE AGAIN AND BEGAN TO SPREAD, AND THE EMPEROR CONSTANTIUS HIMSELF LEANED TOWARDS IT. AT COURT WERE TWO INFLUENTIAL MAGNATES, ЈЕВСЕВИЈЕ AND ФИЛИП, BOTH FIERY ARIANS, AND BY THEIR INFLUENCE THE PATRIARCH PAUL WAS THROWN OFF HIS THRONE AND BANISHED TO ARMENIA, WHERE THE ARIANS STRANGLED HIM; and the patriarchal throne was taken by the wicked МАКЕДОНИЈЕ. At a time when Orthodoxy had two bitter fights to wage at once, against the pagans and against the heretics, these two put their whole strength and resolve into it. THE ARIANS TRIED FIRST TO BRIBE THEM, and when the two refused with contempt they condemned them to death. AT THE PLACE OF EXECUTION THEY RAISED THEIR HANDS AND THANKED GOD FOR A MARTYR’S END: «Господе, радујемо се што оваквом смрћу излазимо из овога живота. Удостој нас, бити причасницима живота вечнога, Ти животе наш!» — Lord, we rejoice that we go out of this life by such a death; count us worthy to be partakers of eternal life, thou who art our life. Then they bowed their holy heads under the sword. AND ST JOHN CHRYSOSTOM LATER RAISED A CHURCH IN THEIR NAME OVER THEIR WONDERWORKING RELICS — which is where these folders’ existing `related` rows to him and to Paul come from on this calendar as well. FOUR PEOPLE NAMED AND NONE GETS A ROW. `paul-the-confessor`, `john-chrysostom` and `constantine-the-great` are all three already on both folders both ways, and none of them is in this heading, so none is owed an attestation — only the prose, which they get. ЈЕВСЕВИЈЕ and ФИЛИП, the two Arian magnates: no folder read here is either, Ruling 3. МАКЕДОНИЈЕ, who took the throne: the corpus holds `macedonius-ii-of-constantinople` and three other Macedonii, and this man is the Arian the book calls «злочестиви» — NOTHING WAS WRITTEN AND NO ROW WAS MADE, because identifying a heresiarch with a saint’s folder on a shared forename is exactly the error the fold keys exist to stop. The emperor Constantius is named and is not a saint. No `locations`: Constantinople and Armenia are named and neither is a coordinate. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion. THE FOLD THIS FORM MAKES: `foldchk.py` measured «Маркијан» as held in sr by `marcian-of-constantinople` and `marcian-of-durostorum`, a pair the gate was printing as UNREAD with no key; this form makes it three folders, so a three-folder key is in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs` in the same commit and there was nothing narrower to delete.

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinţilor Mucenici Marcian şi Martirie. The text is the common of two or more martyrs, as the page prints it, and names neither of them.

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their contests received from Thee our God the crowns of incorruption; for having Thy strength they brought the torturers low, and broke the feeble insolence of the demons. At their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.

hymns.text: Ζῆλον ἔνθεον ἀναλαβόντες, ἠμαυρώσατε Ἀρείου πλάνην ὁμοούσιον Τριάδα κηρύττοντες, Μαρκιανὲ καὶ θέοφρων Μαρτύριε, ὀρθοδοξίας οἱ ἄσειστοι πρόβολοι, θεῖοι μάρτυρες, Χριστῷ τῷ Θεῷ πρεσβεύσατε δωρίσασθαι ἡμῖν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: saint.gr, «Άγιοι Μαρκιανός και Μαρτύριος οι νοτάριοι» — Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος γ’. Θείας πίστεως

english.text: Having taken up a godly zeal, you darkened the error of Arius by preaching the Trinity of one essence, Marcian and God-minded Martyrius, unshaken bulwarks of orthodoxy, divine martyrs: entreat Christ our God to grant us his great mercy.

hymns.text: Ἀγωvισάμενοι καλῶς ἀπὸ βρέφους, Μαρκιανὲ σὺv τῷ σοφῷ Μαρτυρίῳ, τὸv ἀποστάτηv Ἄρειοv καθείλετε, ἄτρωτον τηρήσαντες, τὴν ὀρθόδοξοv πίστιν, Παύλῳ ἐφεπόμενοι, τῷ σοφῷ διδασκάλῳ, ὅθεν σὺv τούτῳ εὔρατε ζωήv, ὡς τῆς Τριάδος ὑπέρμαχοι ἄριστοι.

source.text: saint.gr, «Άγιοι Μαρκιανός και Μαρτύριος οι νοτάριοι» — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’. Ὁ ὑψωθεὶς (copied as the page prints it, Latin v for ν and all)

english.text: Having contended well from infancy, Marcian with the wise Martyrius, you pulled down the apostate Arius and kept the Orthodox faith unwounded, following Paul your wise teacher; and so with him you found life, as the best champions of the Trinity.

hymns.text: Мученик двоица единонравная,/ Маркиан с Мартирием славным,/ Ариево нечестие разрушиша/ и Соприсносущна Сына Отцу и Духови веровати научиша,/ Павлу повинующеся, истинных повелений учителю,/ темже мечем убиени, умроша,/ и присно со Христом живуще,// о нас Того молят спасти души наша.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 25 октября ст. ст. — «Тропарь мучеников Маркиана и Мартирия»

english.text: A pair of martyrs of one mind, Marcian with the glorious Martyrius, undid the impiety of Arius and taught men to believe the Son co-eternal with the Father and the Spirit, obeying Paul, the teacher of true commandments; and so they were killed with the sword and died, and living for ever with Christ they pray Him for us, that He may save our souls.

hymns.text: Подвигшеся добре от младенства,/ Маркиане с мудрым Мартирием,/ отступника Ария низложисте,/ невредно сохраньше Православную веру,/ Павлу последующе, мудрому учителю,/ темже с ним обретосте живот,// яко Троицы поборницы изряднейшии.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 25 октября ст. ст. — «Кондак мучеников Маркиана и Мартирия»

english.text: Having striven well from your infancy, Marcian with the wise Martyrius, you cast down the apostate Arius and kept the Orthodox faith unhurt, following Paul the wise teacher; and so with him you found life, as the most excellent champions of the Trinity.

death.note: saint.gr heads both notaries «(; - 355)»; the narrative gives no year of death and dates their service by «τα χρόνια του Αρειανού βασιλέως Κωνσταντίου (337 - 349 μ.Χ.)».
